design.risk_set: completed prompts still running at landmark; no wall-clock durations
design.matching: within split; distinct sessions; greedy ascending standardized RMS; without replacement; log1p prefix features; dev population SD by age; zero SD uses 1; RMS <= 1 and each absolute coordinate <= 2

signal_definitions.execError: failed tool receipt for an execution with verification or E2E intent
signal_definitions.blocked: updated todo list has a blocked item
signal_definitions.slowTool: non-ask tool reaches 60 active seconds; not proof of blocking

design.post_window_population: already matched pairs with both surviving through landmark + 300 seconds
limitations: Observational matching is not causal; unmeasured differences and greedy matching remain.
Fixed-window survivor conditioning excludes short-window completions and can select on outcome.
Only first signal onset is represented; pre-landmark onset precludes a later first onset.
Exact sign p-values ignore repeated prompts and sessions, multiple signals and landmarks; treat as descriptive.
Missing recorded signal is not proof of absence; small or zero discordance is inconclusive.
Development, official, and enriched cohorts are reported separately; no holdout tuning.
